business_summary: Lai Group Holding Company Limited, an investment holding company, provides residential and commercial interior design and fit-out services in Hong Kong. The company is also involved in the property holding activities. Lai Group Holding Company Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Lai Group Holding Company Limited는 홍콩에서 주거용 및 상업용 인테리어 디자인과 설비 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 또한 자산 보유 활동에도 참여하고 있습니다. Lai Group Holding Company Limited는 1996년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 샤틴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
